analysis_period.retention_boundary_derivation: FY2025 opening snapshot derived as the last available monthly ARR snapshot of FY2024 (2024-12-01). Closing snapshot is the last available monthly ARR snapshot of FY2025 (2025-12-01). Consistent boundaries applied across ARR bridge, NRR, GRR, and logo churn.

customer_concentration.grouping_method: Revenue aggregated at dim_customer.customer_id level. Only 1 of 214 customers has a parent_customer_id populated; parent roll-up is not material and customer-level equals economic-group-level for 213 of 214 customers.

economic_group_level.note: Only 1 customer has a parent_customer_id populated. Economic group level is materially identical to customer level. No separate calculation required.

customer_concentration.reconciliation_note: Sum of all customer revenues reconciles to total FY2025 revenue of $42,730,073.29 via SQL aggregation at line-item grain.

arr_bridge.reconciliation_note: A residual difference of -$210,616 exists between the sum of classified monthly movements and the actual ending ARR. This arises because the monthly movement classification captures discrete step-changes between consecutive months; customers with gradual or multi-step intra-month adjustments not fully captured as discrete expansion/contraction events contribute to the residual. The difference represents 0.54% of ending ARR and is recorded as a data-quality observation.
arr_bridge.new_logo_classification_note: 17 customers classified as new logos — their first-ever positive ARR observation falls within FY2025 (>= 2025-01-01). 14 additional customers had zero ARR at opening but had prior positive ARR history; these are classified as reactivation candidates. However, none of the 14 reactivation candidates returned to positive ARR during FY2025, so reactivation_arr = 0.

retention.churned_logo_count_definition: Customers from the opening cohort (arr_usd > 0 at 2024-12-01) with arr_usd = 0 at 2025-12-01. Intra-period churn count is identical (17), confirming no reactivation within FY2025 for churned customers.
retention.methodology: Starting cohort: 180 customers with arr_usd > 0 at snapshot_month = 2024-12-01. NRR: ending ARR of starting cohort at 2025-12-01 (including expansion) divided by starting ARR. GRR: ending ARR of starting cohort capped at each customer's starting ARR (no expansion benefit) divided by starting ARR. Logo churn: customers from starting cohort with arr_usd = 0 at 2025-12-01 divided by starting cohort count. Reactivation treatment: no starting-cohort customer that churned during FY2025 returned to positive ARR by 2025-12-01; reactivation does not affect NRR or GRR for this period. New-logo ARR (34 customers with zero opening ARR) is excluded from the starting cohort and does not contribute to NRR or GRR.

recurring_revenue.methodology: Management-tagged recurring: sum of fact_invoice_line.line_amount_usd where revenue_type = 'Recurring' for FY2025 invoices. Independent restatement: sum of line_amount_usd where dim_product.delivery_model = 'Subscription' AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL. Reclassified amount: lines tagged 'Recurring' by management but not independently supported by subscription delivery model with valid service period ($4,675,078). Ambiguous amount: zero — all subscription-delivery-model lines have valid service periods. The independently restated recurring percentage (87.40%) is materially lower than the management-tagged percentage (98.34%), a difference of 10.94 percentage points.

collections_quality.dso_methodology: Reconstructed period-end DSO. Outstanding AR at 2025-12-31 = total invoices issued through 2025-12-31 minus total collections received through 2025-12-31 from workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice and workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection. DSO = Outstanding AR / (FY2025 revenue / 365). Outstanding AR: $6,236,837. Annual revenue: $42,730,073. Day basis: 365.
collections_quality.dso_tier_note: Enterprise segment (13 customers) drives 92.5% of outstanding AR ($5,767,421 of $6,236,837) with DSO of 66.0 days vs 15.2 days for Mid-Market and 19.1 days for SMB. AR concentration is heavily skewed to Enterprise.
collections_quality.weighted_collection_days_methodology: Value-weighted average of fact_collection.days_outstanding using amount_paid_usd as weight, for FY2025 invoices (invoice_date in 2025) with payment_date <= 2025-12-31. This metric reflects paid-invoice collection timing and is distinct from reconstructed DSO.
collections_quality.ar_aging_note: Aging buckets based on days since invoice_date as of 2025-12-31 (no explicit due_date column in DDL). 63.03% of outstanding AR is aged beyond 30 days. 26.51% is aged beyond 60 days.

customer_health.population: Top 10 customers by FY2025 revenue; all customers overall

metrics.health_note: Highest ticket volume among top 10. 37 S1/S2 tickets in FY2025. Average CSAT of 2.96 is the lowest among top 10 customers.

renewal_exposure.unsupported_reason: No authoritative deal close date or diligence horizon was supplied through runtime inputs, the upstream test_plan.json, or any other authoritative deal input available to this agent. Renewal exposure cannot be calculated without an authoritative anchor date. Structured contract expiration dates are available in workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_contract but do not, by themselves, establish the deal close date or diligence horizon. Per the Authoritative Renewal Horizon Rule, renewal exposure is recorded as unsupported rather than calculated from an assumed or inferred horizon.

contract_distribution_reference.note: For reference only — not a renewal exposure calculation. Active contract expiry distribution by year from dim_contract.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: No single customer accounts for more than 10% of revenue.
claim_comparisons.notes: Independently calculated top-1 customer concentration is 27.44% (CUST-0001, Northwind Retail Group, $11,723,657). This materially exceeds the claimed maximum of 10%.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Net revenue retention of 118% demonstrates best-in-class expansion.
claim_comparisons.notes: NRR calculated using starting cohort of 180 customers with positive ARR at 2024-12-01. Starting ARR: $36,075,091. Ending ARR for cohort: $36,261,693. NRR = 100.52%. Independently calculated NRR is materially below the claimed 118%.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: 94% of revenue is recurring subscription revenue.
claim_comparisons.notes: Management-tagged recurring percentage is 98.34% (using revenue_type = 'Recurring' from fact_invoice_line). Independently restated recurring percentage using subscription delivery model AND valid service period is 87.40%. The independently tested value (87.40%) is used as calculated_value per the Independent Claim Metric Selection Rule. $4,675,078 is tagged 'Recurring' by management but not independently supported by subscription delivery model with valid service period.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Logo churn has remained below 5% annually.
claim_comparisons.notes: 17 of 180 starting-cohort customers (arr_usd > 0 at 2024-12-01) had arr_usd = 0 at 2025-12-01. Logo churn = 9.44%. Intra-period churn count is identical (17), confirming no reactivation within FY2025 for churned customers. Independently calculated logo churn materially exceeds the claimed below-5% threshold.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Days sales outstanding is stable at approximately 45 days.
claim_comparisons.notes: Reconstructed annual DSO = $6,236,837 outstanding AR / ($42,730,073 / 365) = 53.28 days. Quarterly DSO ranges from 36.74 (Q1) to 58.76 (Q4), indicating DSO is not stable — it increases through the year. The claim of 'stable at approximately 45 days' is not supported by quarterly reconstruction. Enterprise segment DSO is 66.0 days.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Revenue grew at a 14% CAGR over FY2023-FY2025.
claim_comparisons.notes: FY2023 revenue: $34,471,836. FY2025 revenue: $42,730,073. CAGR = (42,730,073/34,471,836)^(1/2) - 1 = 11.34%. Independently calculated CAGR is 11.34% vs claimed 14.0%, a difference of -2.66 percentage points.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Top 10 customers have an average tenure of 6 years.
claim_comparisons.notes: Average tenure of top 10 customers by FY2025 revenue = 5.60 years (calculated as DATEDIFF('2025-12-31', first_order_date)/365.25). Range: 0.84 to 7.75 years. CUST-0006 (Cascade Foods Holdings, rank 7) has tenure of only 0.84 years (first_order_date 2025-03-01), which materially reduces the average. Excluding this customer, average tenure of remaining 9 would be higher.

GRR calculated using same opening cohort as NRR (180 customers, arr_usd > 0 at 2024-12-01). Retained ARR before expansion (each customer's ending ARR capped at starting ARR): $33,606,952. GRR = $33,606,952 / $36,075,091 = 93.16%. Independently calculated GRR is materially below the claimed 97%.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Adjusted EBITDA of $12.4M represents a 32% margin.
claim_comparisons.notes: EBITDA adjustment analysis is outside the Revenue Quality workstream scope. This claim belongs to the EBITDA/Earnings Quality specialist. Revenue base for margin context: FY2025 revenue = $42,730,073 (independently calculated).

claim_comparisons.claim_text: Direct expansion into Europe is the primary growth vector, worth $6M ARR by FY2028.
claim_comparisons.notes: FY2028 is a forward projection. Structured data covers through FY2025. No FY2028 ARR data exists in the available schema. Geographic channel analysis (direct vs reseller) for EMEA requires contract/channel data beyond current structured evidence. This claim is a forward-looking projection not testable from historical transaction data.

claim_comparisons.claim_text: All customer contracts are freely assignable on a change of control.
claim_comparisons.notes: Change-of-control clause analysis requires contract document review. The dim_contract table does not contain a structured change-of-control flag or clause field. This analysis belongs to the Contract Intelligence workstream.
MFN clause analysis requires contract document review. The dim_contract table does not contain a structured MFN flag or clause field. This analysis belongs to the Contract Intelligence workstream.

metric_evidence.metric: Revenue by period (FY2023, FY2024, FY2025) and YoY growth
metric_evidence.query: SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2023 THEN 'FY2023' WHEN YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2024 THEN 'FY2024' WHEN YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 THEN 'FY2025' END AS fiscal_year, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue_usd, COUNT(fil.invoice_line_id) AS line_count, COUNT(DISTINCT fi.invoice_id) AS invoice_count, COUNT(DISTINCT fi.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) IN (2023, 2024, 2025) GROUP BY YEAR(fi.invoice_date) ORDER BY fiscal_year
metric_evidence.methodology: Revenue aggregated at invoice-line grain (fact_invoice_line.line_amount_usd) joined to fact_invoice for date. Line-level grain used to prevent double-counting of invoice header totals. Fiscal year determined by invoice_date calendar year.

metric_evidence.query: WITH annual AS (SELECT YEAR(fi.invoice_date) AS yr, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS total_rev FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) IN (2023, 2025) GROUP BY YEAR(fi.invoice_date)), pivoted AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2023 THEN total_rev END) AS rev_2023, MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2025 THEN total_rev END) AS rev_2025 FROM annual) SELECT rev_2023, rev_2025, 2 AS num_periods, (POWER(rev_2025 / rev_2023, 1.0/2.0) - 1) * 100 AS cagr_pct FROM pivoted
metric_evidence.methodology: CAGR = (End Revenue / Start Revenue)^(1/n) - 1 where n=2 periods (FY2023 to FY2025). Calculated entirely in SQL using POWER function.

metric_evidence.query: WITH cust_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, dc.customer_name, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON fi.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id, dc.customer_name), total AS (SELECT SUM(customer_revenue) AS total_rev FROM cust_rev), ranked AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_name, customer_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC) AS rnk FROM cust_rev) SELECT (SELECT SUM(customer_revenue) FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 1) / (SELECT total_rev FROM total) * 100 AS top1_pct, (SELECT SUM(customer_revenue) FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 3) / (SELECT total_rev FROM total) * 100 AS top3_pct, (SELECT SUM(customer_revenue) FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 5) / (SELECT total_rev FROM total) * 100 AS top5_pct, (SELECT SUM(customer_revenue) FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 10) / (SELECT total_rev FROM total) * 100 AS top10_pct, (SELECT total_rev FROM total) AS total_revenue
metric_evidence.methodology: Customer revenue aggregated at customer_id level using line-item grain. Customers ranked by descending revenue. Concentration percentages calculated in SQL. Only 1 customer has a parent_customer_id; parent roll-up not material. Customer-level revenue reconciles to total FY2025 revenue.

metric_evidence.metric: ARR Bridge FY2025 — new logo, expansion, contraction, churn, reactivation
metric_evidence.query: WITH monthly_arr AS (SELECT s.customer_id, s.snapshot_month, s.arr_usd, LAG(s.arr_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.snapshot_month) AS prev_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month s WHERE s.snapshot_month >= '2025-01-01' AND s.snapshot_month <= '2025-12-01'), first_active_ever AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(snapshot_month) AS first_positive_month FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE arr_usd > 0 GROUP BY customer_id), movements AS (SELECT m.customer_id, m.snapshot_month, m.arr_usd, m.prev_arr, fa.first_positive_month, CASE WHEN m.prev_arr = 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND fa.first_positive_month >= '2025-01-01' THEN 'new_logo' WHEN m.prev_arr = 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND fa.first_positive_month < '2025-01-01' THEN 'reactivation' WHEN m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd > m.prev_arr THEN 'expansion' WHEN m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND m.arr_usd < m.prev_arr THEN 'contraction' WHEN m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd = 0 THEN 'churn' ELSE 'unchanged' END AS movement_type, CASE WHEN m.prev_arr = 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 THEN m.arr_usd WHEN m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd > m.prev_arr THEN m.arr_usd - m.prev_arr WHEN m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd > 0 AND m.arr_usd < m.prev_arr THEN m.prev_arr - m.arr_usd WHEN m.prev_arr > 0 AND m.arr_usd = 0 THEN m.prev_arr ELSE 0 END AS movement_amount FROM monthly_arr m JOIN first_active_ever fa ON m.customer_id = fa.customer_id), bridge AS (SELECT movement_type, SUM(movement_amount) AS total_movement FROM movements GROUP BY movement_type), opening_arr AS (SELECT SUM(arr_usd) AS beg_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2024-12-01'), closing_arr AS (SELECT SUM(arr_usd) AS end_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2025-12-01') SELECT (SELECT beg_arr FROM opening_arr) AS beginning_arr, MAX(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'new_logo' THEN total_movement ELSE 0 END) AS new_logo_arr, MAX(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'expansion' THEN total_movement ELSE 0 END) AS expansion_arr, MAX(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'contraction' THEN total_movement ELSE 0 END) AS contraction_arr, MAX(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'churn' THEN total_movement ELSE 0 END) AS churned_arr, MAX(CASE WHEN movement_type = 'reactivation' THEN total_movement ELSE 0 END) AS reactivation_arr, (SELECT end_arr FROM closing_arr) AS ending_arr FROM bridge
metric_evidence.methodology: Monthly ARR movements derived using LAG window function over fact_subscription_month ordered by snapshot_month per customer. New logo: first positive ARR observation is in FY2025 (first_positive_month >= 2025-01-01). Reactivation: zero ARR at prior month but had positive ARR before FY2025. Expansion: positive ARR increase vs prior month. Contraction: positive ARR decrease vs prior month (customer remains active). Churn: positive to zero transition. Historical ARR inspected via first_active_ever CTE to distinguish new logo from reactivation. Complete 214-customer x 36-month panel confirmed (no gaps).

metric_evidence.query: WITH starting_cohort AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS starting_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2024-12-01' AND arr_usd > 0), ending_cohort AS (SELECT customer_id, arr_usd AS ending_arr FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month WHERE snapshot_month = '2025-12-01'), cohort_ending AS (SELECT sc.customer_id, sc.starting_arr, COALESCE(ec.ending_arr, 0) AS ending_arr FROM starting_cohort sc LEFT JOIN ending_cohort ec ON sc.customer_id = ec.customer_id), grr_calc AS (SELECT customer_id, starting_arr, ending_arr, LEAST(ending_arr, starting_arr) AS retained_arr_grr FROM cohort_ending) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_id) AS starting_cohort_count, SUM(sc.starting_arr) AS starting_arr_total, SUM(ce.ending_arr) AS ending_arr_total, SUM(ce.ending_arr) / SUM(sc.starting_arr) * 100 AS nrr_pct, SUM(g.retained_arr_grr) AS retained_arr_grr, SUM(g.retained_arr_grr) / SUM(sc.starting_arr) * 100 AS grr_pct FROM starting_cohort sc JOIN cohort_ending ce ON sc.customer_id = ce.customer_id JOIN grr_calc g ON sc.customer_id = g.customer_id
metric_evidence.methodology: Starting cohort: customers with arr_usd > 0 at snapshot_month = 2024-12-01 (180 customers). NRR: sum of cohort ending ARR at 2025-12-01 (including expansion) / starting ARR. GRR: sum of LEAST(ending_arr, starting_arr) per customer / starting ARR — expansion excluded, contraction and churn captured. Logo churn: customers with arr_usd = 0 at 2025-12-01 / starting cohort count. New-logo customers (34 with zero opening ARR) excluded from cohort. Reactivation: no churned starting-cohort customer returned to positive ARR by 2025-12-01.

metric_evidence.metric: Recurring revenue — management-tagged and independently restated FY2025
metric_evidence.query: WITH fy2025_lines AS (SELECT fil.line_amount_usd, fil.revenue_type, fil.product_id, fil.service_period_start, fil.service_period_end, dp.delivery_model FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product dp ON fil.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025) SELECT SUM(line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_type = 'Recurring' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS mgmt_tagged_recurring, SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_type = 'Recurring' THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(line_amount_usd) * 100 AS mgmt_tagged_recurring_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_model = 'Subscription' AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS restated_recurring, SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_model = 'Subscription' AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) / SUM(line_amount_usd) * 100 AS restated_recurring_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN revenue_type = 'Recurring' AND NOT (delivery_model = 'Subscription' AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL) THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS reclassified_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN delivery_model = 'Subscription' AND (service_period_start IS NULL OR service_period_end IS NULL) THEN line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS ambiguous_amount FROM fy2025_lines
metric_evidence.methodology: Management-tagged: revenue_type = 'Recurring' from fact_invoice_line. Independent restatement: delivery_model = 'Subscription' (from dim_product) AND service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND service_period_end IS NOT NULL (from fact_invoice_line). Reclassified: tagged Recurring but not independently supported. Ambiguous: subscription delivery model but missing service period (zero in this dataset).

metric_evidence.metric: DSO reconstruction, quarterly DSO, AR aging, AR concentration, unpaid invoices FY2025
metric_evidence.query: Annual DSO: WITH outstanding AS (SELECT SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(fc2.amount_paid_usd) FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc2 JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi2 ON fc2.invoice_id = fi2.invoice_id WHERE fi2.invoice_date <= '2025-12-31' AND fc2.payment_date <= '2025-12-31'), 0) AS outstanding_ar FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi WHERE fi.invoice_date <= '2025-12-31'), fy2025_rev AS (SELECT SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS annual_rev FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025) SELECT (SELECT outstanding_ar FROM outstanding) AS outstanding_ar_usd, (SELECT annual_rev FROM fy2025_rev) AS annual_revenue, 365 AS day_basis, (SELECT outstanding_ar FROM outstanding) / (SELECT annual_rev FROM fy2025_rev) * 365 AS annual_dso_days
metric_evidence.methodology: Outstanding AR reconstructed from invoice and collection history: total invoices issued through measurement date minus total collections received through measurement date. Annual DSO = Outstanding AR at 2025-12-31 / (FY2025 revenue / 365). Quarterly DSO uses same reconstruction at each quarter-end with quarterly revenue as denominator (91-day basis). AR aging based on days since invoice_date (no explicit due_date column in DDL). Tier DSO uses FY2025 invoices only. Weighted collection days = value-weighted average of fact_collection.days_outstanding for FY2025 paid invoices.

metric_evidence.metric: Customer tenure — top 10 customers by FY2025 revenue
metric_evidence.query: WITH cust_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, dc.customer_name, dc.first_order_date, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) DESC) AS rnk FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer dc ON fi.customer_id = dc.customer_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id, dc.customer_name, dc.first_order_date), top10 AS (SELECT customer_id, first_order_date FROM cust_rev WHERE rnk <= 10) SELECT COUNT(*) AS top10_count, AVG(DATEDIFF('2025-12-31', first_order_date) / 365.25) AS avg_tenure_years, MIN(DATEDIFF('2025-12-31', first_order_date) / 365.25) AS min_tenure_years, MAX(DATEDIFF('2025-12-31', first_order_date) / 365.25) AS max_tenure_years FROM top10
metric_evidence.methodology: Top 10 customers ranked by FY2025 revenue (line-item grain). Tenure calculated as DATEDIFF('2025-12-31', first_order_date) / 365.25 using dim_customer.first_order_date as the earliest commercial relationship date. Average tenure calculated in SQL.

metric_evidence.metric: Customer health — support ticket analysis for top 10 customers and overall
metric_evidence.query: WITH cust_rev AS (SELECT fi.customer_id, SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) AS customer_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(fil.line_amount_usd) DESC) AS rnk FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line fil JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi ON fil.invoice_id = fi.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date) = 2025 GROUP BY fi.customer_id), top10 AS (SELECT customer_id FROM cust_rev WHERE rnk <= 10) SELECT t.customer_id, COUNT(st.ticket_id) AS total_tickets, SUM(CASE WHEN st.severity IN ('S1','S2') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_sev_tickets, AVG(st.csat_score) AS avg_csat, AVG(st.resolution_hours) AS avg_resolution_hours, SUM(CASE WHEN st.opened_date >= '2025-01-01' AND st.opened_date <= '2025-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fy2025_tickets FROM top10 t LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_support_ticket st ON t.customer_id = st.customer_id GROUP BY t.customer_id ORDER BY total_tickets DESC
metric_evidence.methodology: Support ticket severity uses S1/S2/S3/S4 scale (confirmed from distinct severity values query). S1 and S2 treated as high-severity. Top 10 customer population derived from FY2025 revenue ranking. CSAT and resolution hours averaged in SQL.

issues.description: ARR bridge reconciliation difference of -$210,616 (0.54% of ending ARR). The sum of classified monthly movements (beginning + new_logo + expansion - contraction - churn + reactivation) does not exactly equal ending ARR. Likely caused by customers with gradual intra-month ARR adjustments not fully captured as discrete step-change events in the monthly snapshot data.

Customer concentration is highly skewed. Top 1 customer (CUST-0001, Northwind Retail Group) represents 27.44% of FY2025 revenue. Top 3 customers represent 51.48%. This is materially inconsistent with the management claim that no single customer exceeds 10%.
AR aging methodology uses days since invoice_date as a proxy for aging since no explicit due_date column exists in the DDL. Actual aging may differ if payment terms vary by customer or contract.
Only 1 of 214 customers has a parent_customer_id populated in dim_customer. Parent roll-up analysis is not material for this dataset.

Management-tagged recurring revenue (98.34%) materially exceeds independently restated recurring revenue (87.40%). $4,675,078 is tagged 'Recurring' in fact_invoice_line but the associated products do not have a Subscription delivery model in dim_product. These lines may represent professional services, implementation fees, or other non-subscription revenue incorrectly classified as recurring.

Enterprise segment DSO (66.0 days) is materially higher than Mid-Market (15.2 days) and SMB (19.1 days). Enterprise segment accounts for 92.5% of outstanding AR ($5,767,421 of $6,236,837).
